scenes.alt: SKYCOT signup page with email input and a magic-link option
scenes.caption: Sign up at app.skycot.com with an email you can read on this device.

scenes.alt: Onboarding step 1 — welcome screen previewing the five-step setup
scenes.caption: Welcome step previews workspace, provider, vertical and first-hire stages.

scenes.alt: Onboarding step 2 — workspace name and company inputs
scenes.caption: Name the workspace; SKYCOT provisions a fresh tenant with its own audit chain.

scenes.alt: Onboarding step 3 — provider selector for Anthropic, OpenAI and mock
scenes.caption: Paste an Anthropic key for real LLM output, or pick the mock provider.

scenes.alt: Onboarding step 4 — vertical pack grid (marketing intern, SDR, support, AR clerk, GTM engineer)
scenes.caption: Pick a vertical — each pack ships persona, skills, escalation policy, evals.

scenes.alt: Onboarding step 5 — first-hire form with worker name and short job description
scenes.caption: Name your first worker and describe the work in plain English.

scenes.alt: Team page showing Maya as the first hired worker with status and last-action time
scenes.caption: Team page lists every hired worker, current state and recent activity.

scenes.alt: Worker profile for Mariah with persona summary, skills, trust grade and recent runs
scenes.caption: Worker profile carries persona, skills, trust grade, memory and audit links.

scenes.alt: Approvals inbox with Slack-style action approval cards, risk scores and approve / reject buttons
scenes.caption: Approval cards land in the inbox; one click approves, one click rejects.

scenes.alt: Audit trail timeline with action rows, channel badges and verdict markers
scenes.caption: Every step a worker takes lands on the audit trail with channel, cost and verdict.

scenes.alt: Marketplace browse view of vertical packs with skill counts and persona summaries
scenes.caption: Marketplace lists vertical packs — install one to seed a worker with skills and evals.

scenes.alt: Skill canvas editor with node-based flow of steps and an inline diff panel
scenes.caption: Skill canvas lets you edit a worker's playbook as a node graph; every change is diffed.
